crossref.title: ArrayExpress: a public database of gene expression data at EBI
crossref.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    ArrayExpress is a public repository for microarray-based gene expression data, resulting from the implementation of the MAGE object model to ensure accurate data structuring and the MIAME standard, which defines the annotation requirements. ArrayExpress accepts data as MAGE–ML files for direct submissions or data from MIAMExpress, the MIAME compliant web-based annotation and submission tool of EBI. A team of curators supports the submission process, providing assistance in data annotation. Data retrieval is performed through a dedicated web interface. Relevant results may be exported to Expression-Profiler, the EBI based expression analysis tool available online (
                    <jats:ext-link xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:href="http://www.ebi.ac.uk/arrayexpress">http://www.ebi.ac.uk/arrayexpress</jats:ext-link>
                    ).
                  </jats:p>
